vt1019023.title: Sony Cyber-shot DSC-T10 Black 7.2MP Carl Zeiss 3x Zoom Digital Camera Tested
vt1019023.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1019023.details: Sony Cyber-shot DSC-T10 slim compact digital camera in black with a 7.2 megapixel CCD sensor, a Carl Zeiss Vario-Tessar 3x optical zoom lens, Super SteadyShot optical image stabilization, face detection and a slide-type lens cover that also works as the power switch. 2.5-inch LCD, about 56 MB of internal memory, and it records to Memory Stick Duo cards (SD cards cannot be used). Condition per the seller: several small paint chips on the body, with few conspicuous scratches or stains. The seller checked power on/off, shooting, playback and charging; other functions and the battery capacity were not checked. Included, as shown in the photos: the camera, a lithium-ion battery (NP-FT1) and a charger. No memory card or strap is included.
vt1019023.why: A used Sony Cyber-shot DSC-T10 compact digital camera in black with a battery and charger.
vt1019023.perfect: Compact digital camera fans who like the slim 2000s Cyber-shot look.
vt1019023.exp: A pre-owned Sony DSC-T10 in the condition described above, with the small paint chips noted.
vt1019023.cd: Pre-owned with several small paint chips on the body and no conspicuous scratches or stains in the photos. The seller checked power on/off, shooting, playback and charging; other functions and the battery capacity were not checked. Includes the camera, a lithium-ion battery and a charger. Uses Memory Stick Duo cards, not SD. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
